channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky says ‘founder mode’ cost him almost his entire executive team: ‘They left or they didn’t want to work for me’
item.description: Chesky was a natural founder but a “terrible CEO,” he said, and fixing that meant losing executives who wouldn’t adapt.

item.title: The richest 10% outspend the poorest quarter over 13 to 1 per child on childcare, education and activities — up from about 3 to 1 in the early 1980s
item.description: Before age 5, children from the poorest fourth of families receive about $44,000 less in total investments than children from the richest fourth.

item.title: Trump approved nearly 90% of disaster aid requests from all-Republican states and only 23% from all-Democratic ones
item.description: FEMA owes local governments almost $10 billion in reimbursements for recovery work that cities and towns have already paid for.

item.title: States agreed to ‘fully, finally, and forever’ release Meta from claims they didn’t know existed — with $459 million for Cambridge Analytica claims
item.description: The judge also concluded the company failed to notify users about thousands of applications associated with data misuse.
